topic: Adult Drosophila behavior, senses, internal state and reproduction

access_priorities.reason: Full methods and supplements for bilateral odor stimulus calibration; data and code already public.
Full methods and supplements if reproducing LC10 tuning and courtship intervention quantitatively.
Full methods for duration and dissociation of coital mechanosensory versus ejaculate effects.
Full methods for quantitative sperm-bound SP release and persistence; abstract suffices for model architecture.
Full methods if fitting thermal projection-neuron response kernels.
Full methods if reproducing LPLC2 receptive fields and intervention phenotypes.
Full methods if fitting reward learning at cell/compartment level.
